metadata.question: Was surface water present in the Alvord Desert basin, Oregon, on June 29, 2025?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Region: Rectangle around Alvord Desert basin, Oregon (approx): [-118.70, 42.45, -118.45, 42.65].
- Target date: 2025-06-29 (UTC). First try exact day window [2025-06-29, 2025-06-30). If no images, fallback to Landsat 8/9 for same day. If still none, widen to ±3 days [2025-06-26, 2025-07-02] and retry S2 then Landsat.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Apply cloud/cirrus mask:
  - Sentinel-2 L2A: QA60 bits 10 (cloud) and 11 (cirrus).
  - Landsat C2 L2: QA_PIXEL bits 1 (dilated cloud), 2 (cirrus), 3 (cloud), 4 (cloud shadow), 5 (snow).
- Compute MNDWI = (Green - SWIR1) / (Green + SWIR1). Water where MNDWI > 0.2.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collections empty after attempts => C1.
- If images exist but after masking valid pixel count == 0 => C2.
- If any derived metric is null/NaN or outside [0,100] for percent => C3.
- Else: waterCount > 0 => A (Yes); else B (No).
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const region = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-118.70, 42.45, -118.45, 42.65], null, false);
    const targetDate = ee.Date('2025-06-29');
    const dayStart = targetDate;
    const dayEnd = targetDate.advance(1, 'day');
    const wideStart = targetDate.advance(-3, 'day');
    const wideEnd = targetDate.advance(3, 'day');

    // Helper: Collections
    function s2Col(start, end) {
      return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
        .filterBounds(region)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filter(ee.Filter.lte('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80));
    }
    function landsatCol(start, end) {
      const l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(region).filterDate(start, end);
      const l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(region).filterDate(start, end);
      return l8.merge(l9).filter(ee.Filter.lte('CLOUD_COVER', 80));
    }

    // Helper: Closest image to target date
    function closestImage(col) {
      const withDiff = col.map(function(img) {
        const diff = img.date().difference(targetDate, 'day').abs();
        return img.set('diffDays', diff);
      });
      return ee.Image(withDiff.sort('diffDays').first());
    }

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    const s2Day = s2Col(dayStart, dayEnd);
    const lsDay = landsatCol(dayStart, dayEnd);
    const s2DaySize = (await s2Day.size().getInfo()) || 0;
    const lsDaySize = (await lsDay.size().getInfo()) || 0;

    console.log(`Region area (km2): ${((await region.area().getInfo())/1e6).toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(`S2 images on 2025-06-29: ${s2DaySize}; L8/9: ${lsDaySize}`);

    let used = null;
    let src = null;
    let winStart = null;
    let winEnd = null;

    if (s2DaySize > 0) {
      used = closestImage(s2Day);
      src = 'S2';
      winStart = dayStart;
      winEnd = dayEnd;
    } else if (lsDaySize > 0) {
      used = closestImage(lsDay);
      src = 'L8/9';
      winStart = dayStart;
      winEnd = dayEnd;
    } else {
      // Widen window
      const s2Wide = s2Col(wideStart, wideEnd);
      const lsWide = landsatCol(wideStart, wideEnd);
      const s2WideSize = (await s2Wide.size().getInfo()) || 0;
      const lsWideSize = (await lsWide.size().getInfo()) || 0;
      if (s2WideSize > 0) {
        used = closestImage(s2Wide);
        src = 'S2';
        winStart = wideStart;
        winEnd = wideEnd;
      } else if (lsWideSize > 0) {
        used = closestImage(lsWide);
        src = 'L8/9';
        winStart = wideStart;
        winEnd = wideEnd;
      } else {
        console.log('No images found in date/location window.');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
    }

    // 3. Processing (masking and MNDWI)
    function maskS2(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA60');
      const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).neq(0).or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).neq(0));
      const m = cloud.not();
      return img.updateMask(m);
    }
    function maskLandsat(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0) // dilated cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0))     // cirrus
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0))     // cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0))     // cloud shadow
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0));    // snow
      return img.updateMask(mask);
    }
    let img = used;
    let cloudProp = null;
    if (src === 'S2') {
      img = maskS2(img);
      cloudProp = await img.get('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE').getInfo();
    } else {
      img = maskLandsat(img);
      cloudProp = await img.get('CLOUD_COVER').getInfo();
    }

    // Compute MNDWI
    let green, swir1;
    if (src === 'S2') {
      green = img.select('B3');
      swir1 = img.select('B11');
    } else {
      green = img.select('SR_B3');
      swir1 = img.select('SR_B6');
    }
    const mndwi = green.subtract(swir1).divide(green.add(swir1)).rename('mndwi');

    // 4. Calculation (counts at 1 km to avoid timeout)
    const validCount = await mndwi.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: region,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      tileScale: 2
    }).get('mndwi').getInfo();

    if (validCount === null || validCount === 0) {
      console.log(`Used: ${src}; Window: ${winStart.format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo()} to ${winEnd.format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo()} (Δ${(await used.get('diffDays').getInfo())} d); Image date: ${ee.Date(used.get('system:time_start')).format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo()}; Cloud prop: ${cloudProp !== null ? cloudProp : 'NA'}%`);
      console.log('No valid pixels after masking.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    const waterMask = mndwi.gt(0.2).selfMask();
    const waterCells = await waterMask.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: region,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      tileScale: 2
    }).get('mndwi').getInfo();

    const usedDate = ee.Date(used.get('system:time_start')).format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo();
    const deltaDays = await used.get('diffDays').getInfo();
    const waterCount = waterCells || 0;
    const waterPct = (waterCount / validCount) * 100;

    if (!isFinite(waterPct) || waterPct < 0 || waterPct > 100) {
      console.log('Calculation invalid (percent out of range or NaN).');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    console.log(`Used: ${src}; Window: ${winStart.format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo()} to ${winEnd.format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo()} (Δ${deltaDays} d); Image date: ${usedDate}; Cloud prop: ${cloudProp !== null ? cloudProp : 'NA'}%`);
    console.log(`Valid km-cells: ${validCount}; Water cells (MNDWI>0.2): ${waterCount}; Water %: ${waterPct.toFixed(2)}`);

    // 5. Final Answer
    if (waterCount > 0) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
